title: The cone differential preserves finite horizontal tails
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] in which every natural-indexed first-quadrant bicomplex has a total complex [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let $f:A\to B$ be a morphism of such bicomplexes, and let $M=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(\operatorname{Tot}(f)))$. For $h\in\mathbb N$ and integer $m\ge0$, let $s_{K,h,m}$ be the total inclusion of $K^{h,m-h}$, followed by the inverse extension isomorphism into $(\operatorname{extend}\operatorname{Tot}(K))^m$, and put it equal to zero if $m<0$ or $h>m$. Let $J_{h,n}$ be the join of the images of $s_{A,h,n+1}$ followed by the source cone inclusion and $s_{B,h,n}$ followed by the target cone inclusion. Define $S_{p,n}$ to be the finite supremum of $J_{h,n}$ for natural $h<(n+2).toNat$ with $p\le h$. Then $S_{p,n+1}$ contains the image of $S_{p,n}\hookrightarrow M^n\xrightarrow{d}M^{n+1}$ for all integers $p,n$; equivalently this composite factors through $S_{p,n+1}$.

proof.text: On a total summand of horizontal index h, expand the extended total differential using extend_d_eq, ι_D₁ and ι_D₂. Its two summands have horizontal indices h+1 and h. Each factors through any subobject containing the corresponding horizontal generators. Integer scalar multiplication preserves such a factorization. Outside the finite diagonal the summand inclusion is zero.

proof.text: A cone source generator followed by the cone differential is the negative source-total differential plus f followed by the target inclusion (homotopyCofiber.inlX_d). The total map preserves horizontal index (ιTotalOrZero_map and extendMap_f). A target generator followed by the differential is its target-total differential followed by the target inclusion. Thus all generating maps of S_{p,n}, composed with d, factor through S_{p,n+1}.

proof.text: Pull S_{p,n+1} back along the cone differential. Each generating image is contained in that pullback by pullback_factors. Taking the finite supremum, including its source/target binary joins, gives S_{p,n} contained in the pullback. The pullback factorization criterion yields the asserted restricted differential.

theorem coneHorizontal_step_stable
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (p n : ℤ) :
    (coneHorizontalStep f p (n + 1)).Factors
      ((coneHorizontalStep f p n).arrow ≫
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone
          (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
            ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).d n (n + 1))
